title: Azusawa Kohane — Lasting Heat〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Flea Market
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm glad we were able to buy a lot of nice souvenirs.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Since everything was handmade, it was all so unique and charming!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. They even let us take a lot of photos, so I really want to show them to Miku and the others later.
Oh, there you two are.
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Shinonome, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, where'd Slade and Cedric go?
I thought they were with you guys.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Those two are over at that shop asking the owner a bunch of different questions.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's an antique shop, and they seemed to really hit it off with the shopkeeper. They're apparently going to buy some items he recommended.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They told us that they'd wrap up fast, and to stick around this area.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, why don't we take a look at—

rows.Speaker: Shopper
rows.Line: “Huh? Hey, you...”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Shopper
rows.Line: “You're the girl that was singing with illys earlier, right?”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
illys...
Oh!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I guess he was there when I sang with Elena and Becky...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Umm...
“Yes, that's right.”

rows.Speaker: Shopper
rows.Line: “I knew it! The way you sang was so awesome! I'd love to hear you perform again sometime.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Th-Thank you very much...!”

rows.Speaker: Shopper
rows.Line: “You're welcome! Anyway, good luck with everything!”
se_walk_men_001_3

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-That was startling...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Way to go, Kohane!
You have an American fan now!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He certainly seemed passionate.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A fan? I don't know...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that person's totally your fan!
Who would've thought we'd run into one here?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The alleyway you sang in is just over there. Makes sense some of the folks who were coming to the flea market saw you on the way.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which means we may yet run into more of your fans, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I'm not so sure about that, but...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
“Wow...!
Are these teddy bears handmade?”

rows.Speaker: Shopkeeper
rows.Line: “Yes, they are. If you like them, then please feel free to take a closer... Huh? Wait, you're that girl who was singing earlier, aren't you?”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Shopkeeper
rows.Line: “I caught a glimpse of your performance during my break. Your voice is so powerful.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Th-Thank you very much...!”

rows.Speaker: Shopper
rows.Line: “Hey, you're that girl who was singing over there!”

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
“Can you sing something for us?!
I'll play something on one of my guitars!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “U-Uhh...”

rows.Speaker: Shopper
rows.Line:
“Hey, don't scare her.
Sorry about that, Miss. Needless to say, we're all looking forward to the next time we get to hear you sing.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Thank you!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's amazing, Kohane.
Everybody wants to talk to you now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Again, I'm a little surprised.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I guess it shows that Elena and Becky carry a lot of influence around here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, the way those two sang was pretty incredible...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But that's not the only reason why all these people wanna talk to you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He's right. They're interested in you because the feelings in your song came through to them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see. I sure hope that's true.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, now I really feel like singing too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You remember we have an event to go to, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You're probably going to want to sing even more after seeing it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Absolutely!
Can't I just get it out of my system now?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Stop trying to cause a disturbance.
